title: Get completed help as the configured operator
precondition: Approved root policy and authenticated target CLI
basicFlow: Operator submits ordinary helper prompt without overrides; helper resolves Grok and sharpninja; generic worker verifies UID; answer and cleanup correlated
alternativeAndExceptionFlow: Unavailable worker, identity mismatch, incomplete answer or echo: fail without local fallback
postcondition: Completed actual answer and verified cleanup, MCP identity unchanged

title: Explicitly select a different strategy without default leakage
precondition: Registered strategy and permitted local/profile execution
basicFlow: Select Codex or another existing strategy; scoped defaults resolve; same selected implementation executes
alternativeAndExceptionFlow: Unknown alias/config duplicate or unsupported crossUID capability/policy: named failure, not Grok replacement

title: Execute supported callers with workspace/admin identity
precondition: Per-request workspace context and approved profile
basicFlow: Resolve operation workspace, preserve null/empty semantics and explicit admin fallback, invoke generic selected strategy
alternativeAndExceptionFlow: Active denied feature blocks rollout absent named approval; no public UID override or wrong-account retry
postcondition: All matrix callers either execute desired UID or explicitly fail before launch

title: Use full delegated conversation and cancel safely
basicFlow: Read/stream initial response, send/stream subsequent prompt, escape/end/dispose; preserve batch/interactive result/PID
alternativeAndExceptionFlow: Concurrent op Busy; cancellation/disconnect closes descendants; no resume or prompt replay
postcondition: Correct result semantics and session cleanup receipt

title: Reject unauthorized or malformed delegated launch
precondition: Restricted socket and readable immutable policy
basicFlow: Authorized peer submits allowed framed request; validate schema/profile/runtime before launch
alternativeAndExceptionFlow: Wrong peer, injected identity/env/secret, malformed/oversize/replayed frame or mutable path rejected without value leakage
postcondition: No unauthorized launch, safe typed failure and preserved audit

title: Recover worker and descendant resources after failure
precondition: Persisted registry and running invocation/session units
basicFlow: Record launch before submission; on exit/crash stop all registered units, capture receipts, drain/read/delete, restart admission only after proof
alternativeAndExceptionFlow: Manager unavailable or cleanup unknown: unhealthy and retain resources, operator recovery required
postcondition: No leaked descendant/files or false cleanup success

title: Admit help while general work is busy
precondition: Named approval of general-lane blocking and configured deadlines
basicFlow: General voice holds its slot; helper uses reserved slot independently
alternativeAndExceptionFlow: Second helper/general gets immediate Busy; open voice blocks general TODO/requirements/parser up to approved hard limit
postcondition: At most two CLI invocations, helper not starved, release only after cleanup

title: Deploy or roll back a verified release using Nuke
precondition: Known prerequisite schema/host release, approved source/test/artifact digest, administrator auth
basicFlow: Unprivileged Nuke builds tested bundle, fixed elevation locks journal, backs up, verifies worker then MCP, merges approved configuration, verifies real goal
alternativeAndExceptionFlow: Any transition/crash resumes or rolls back exact known state; unsafe recovery stops admission/services, retains evidence
postcondition: Accepted verified release or verified old-state restore, no data/schema mutation

title: Review major-phase evidence without per-increment HV
precondition: Every increment evidence retained and major phase complete
basicFlow: Developer validates mocks then real red/green/refactor and full regressions per increment; completed phase provides immutable scope and full evidence to Claude
alternativeAndExceptionFlow: Missing AC/test/UC link, skipped/failed/empty suite, incomplete receipts/audit or sub98 verdict blocks next phase
postcondition: Major-phase review complete with >=98 scores and durable full verdict/readback, no HV inside increments
